remarks: This is definitely a show stopper and is your opportunity to own this beautiful freehold town home. The Abbey is a total departure from the traditional, designed with contemporary lifestyles and ever-changing family dynamics in mind. You'll find an ultra luxury primary bedroom on the top floor of this plan with an ensuite bathroom. Along with a second bedroom and a second full bathroom. The spacious main floor kitchen offers extra prep space with a large L shaped kitchen. This floor also features the open concept living space. The ground level houses a private a single oversized attached garage, a welcoming foyer with closet space, powder room and an ultra private den / or Bedroom away from the main living space - ideal for a home office,  quiet yoga studio or even a guest bedroom. This home includes full landscaping and a fenced front yard. This home is under construction and will be complete in December of 2026 the photos used are from the same layout recently built but the colors may vary (id:67522)
